# The vacask-ngspice cell's failing steps (`tests/test_pair.rs`): `<deck> <step 1..6> <class> <proof>`,
# compared by (deck, step) both ways, class included (a refusal's class names its features). A
# line goes the day its step passes. Recorded after step2-passes 42e17438.., step2-ngspice
# b36494ca.. and ir-next 64e3c8ef: F3 (int_literal_to_plain), F4 (as_given_to_given_zero,
# pulse_vacask_to_spice) and F6 (ba0dd4c6: model before value) are gone; F5 went with div_typed_to_div runnable for ngspice (step2-passes 6a340ea0).
# Proofs: `pass=<name>` the pass rewrite/DIALECT-VACASK.md §6.2 (or REWRITE-PLAN §4.4) plans for the
# feature refused (not registered on the trunk); `finding=<id>` a pair finding sent to the lead:
#   F7  WRONG NUMBER (fixed in the reader by step2-vacask, R70/A43; now refused, not converted): `alter instance("__topinst__") a=2.0` (a top-level parameter, VACASK
#       re-elaborates) is read as a device-parameter alter of an element `__topinst__` and
#       written `alter @__topinst__[a]=2`; ngspice-45: "no such device or model name
#       __topinst__", every op at a=1 (corpus test/test_cblock.sim). Owner: the VACASK reader
#       (an AlterParam target), or the IR (a device alter naming no element), then the ngspice
#       writer (alterparam and reset).
alter_toplevel 2 refused:U0001,W1401:Run(AlterParamAtOnce) finding=F7 # the IR round: VACASK's alter takes effect at once, ngspice's alterparam at the next reset; no rule converts it yet (W1401 beside it)
case_names 2 refused:U0001:Extra(CaseSensitiveNames) pass=rename_collisions # r1/R1 and out/OUT, which ngspice would fold to one (REWRITE-PLAN §3.1, §4.4)
dc_sweep_pulse 2 refused:U0001:Item(Opaque) ruling=R64 # R64a: the reader keeps a dc sweep of a pulse source Private (P2314)
dc_device_param 2 refused:U0001:Run(DcAxisDeviceParam)+Run(SweepDcList) ruling=R75 # runrules: a continued sweep over a diode's area; dc_axes_to_loops fires only on a restarting DC (R72), so the axis stays (its U0415 note) until R75's per-axis continuation
dc_nested 2 refused:U0001:Run(DcOuterCarries) ruling=R75 # VACASK carries the solve across outer steps, ngspice cannot: refused even on a circuit with one operating point
latch 2 refused:U0001:Run(DcOuterCarries) finding=F8 # R75: F8's wrong number is now a refusal toward ngspice
latch_vdd 2 refused:U0001:Run(DcOuterCarries) finding=F8 # as latch
mos3_ac 4 mismatch finding=F27 # R94: ngspice-45 level 3 small-signal gm is not the derivative of its DC law (ac i(vd) 4.9% apart; DC agrees)
mos9_ac 4 mismatch finding=F27 # R94: as mos3_ac for level 9
mos6_ac 4 target-fails finding=F28 # R94: ngspice-45 has no AC for MOS level 6 ("doAnalyses: matrix is singular"), its raw file ends in the header
diode_isr 4 mismatch finding=F31 # R95: as ngspice-vacask: op vd:flow(br) 1.66074e-9 (VACASK) vs 2.0199e-12 A (ngspice), tol 9.321e-12; held to the current floor since the vector typing fix, at the voltage floor (2e-6) it passed
